nodes.name: AST_BOS
nodes.rationale: Sentinel/null metadata; never executable by itself.

nodes.name: AST_SAYI
nodes.rationale: Native integer literal emission.

nodes.name: AST_GERCEK_SAYI
nodes.rationale: Native IEEE floating literal emission.

nodes.name: AST_METIN
nodes.rationale: Native string storage and pointer emission.

nodes.name: AST_KIMLIK
nodes.rationale: Name resolution and local/global load.

nodes.name: AST_IKILI_OP
nodes.rationale: Arithmetic, comparison and logical operators.

nodes.name: AST_ATAMA
nodes.rationale: Checked assignment emission.

nodes.name: AST_DEGISKEN_TANIMI
nodes.rationale: Local/global declaration and frame layout.

nodes.name: AST_EGER
nodes.rationale: Conditional branch lowering.

nodes.name: AST_DONGU
nodes.rationale: Loop lowering and back-edge patching.

nodes.name: AST_ISLEV
nodes.rationale: Function definition and ABI emission.

nodes.name: AST_ISLEV_CAGRISI
nodes.rationale: Function call and argument ABI.

nodes.name: AST_DONDUR
nodes.rationale: Return emission.

nodes.name: AST_BLOK
nodes.rationale: Nested statement sequence lowering.

nodes.name: AST_DURDUR
nodes.rationale: Break target patching.

nodes.name: AST_DEVAM_ET
nodes.rationale: Continue target patching.

nodes.name: AST_YAPI_TANIMI
nodes.rationale: Struct layout is registered before executable emission.

nodes.name: AST_ALAN_ERISIMI
nodes.rationale: Struct field address/load lowering.

nodes.name: AST_INDEKS_ERISIMI
nodes.rationale: Bounds-checked index lowering.

nodes.name: AST_UNARY
nodes.rationale: Unary and dereference lowering.

nodes.name: AST_REFERANS
nodes.rationale: Address-of/reference lowering.

nodes.name: AST_ICE_AKTAR
nodes.rationale: Import resolution and namespace rewrite happen before codegen.

nodes.name: AST_MAKRO_TANIMI
nodes.rationale: Macro definition is consumed by the expansion pass.

nodes.name: AST_MAKRO_CAGRISI
nodes.rationale: Expanded body is emitted; leaked call is not silently accepted.

nodes.name: AST_GENERIC_TANIM
nodes.rationale: Generic metadata is monomorphized; leaked metadata fails closed with E043.

nodes.name: AST_TRAIT_TANIM
nodes.rationale: Trait constraints are checked before executable emission.

nodes.name: AST_MANTIK
nodes.rationale: true/false now parse as AST_MANTIK and emit canonical 1/0.

nodes.name: AST_DIREKTIF_PROMPT
nodes.rationale: The existing inline-assembly directive lowering is native and fail-closed for unknown bytes.

nodes.name: AST_DIREKTIF_AI
nodes.rationale: AI/prompt directives are consumed by the gateway before codegen; leakage is rejected.

nodes.name: AST_DIREKTIF_C_LIB
nodes.rationale: C library metadata is recorded for the target linker; it emits no standalone instructions.

nodes.name: AST_DIREKTIF_CPP_LIB
nodes.rationale: No native C++ provider is part of the YKN codegen product path; E043 is mandatory.

nodes.name: AST_DIREKTIF_PY_LIB
nodes.rationale: Python is an external compatibility provider, not a codegen dependency; direct leakage is rejected.

nodes.name: AST_DIREKTIF_RS_LIB
nodes.rationale: No Rust provider is part of the YKN codegen product path; E043 is mandatory.

nodes.name: AST_SORU_ISLEMI
nodes.rationale: Result propagation and failure branch lowering.

nodes.name: AST_SONUC_TANIM
nodes.rationale: Result type metadata is consumed; constructors have executable call lowering.

nodes.name: AST_MODUL
nodes.rationale: Module namespace is flattened/mangled before native emission.

nodes.name: AST_ENUM_TANIMI
nodes.rationale: Enum layout and variants are registered before codegen.

nodes.name: AST_TIP_ALIAS
nodes.rationale: Type aliases affect resolution only and never emit instructions.

nodes.name: AST_DIREKTIF_CONVERT
nodes.rationale: Convert execution belongs to the explicit provider pipeline; an unconsumed node cannot produce an artifact.

nodes.name: AST_FSTRING
nodes.rationale: Interpolation lowers to native string composition.

nodes.name: AST_TRAIT_UYGULAMA
nodes.rationale: Trait implementation registrations are consumed before codegen; ID is distinct from AST_MANTIK.

nodes.name: AST_ASYNC_ISLEV
nodes.rationale: Async functions lower to cooperative coroutines returning Future<T> with AsyncFrame state-machine semantics.

nodes.name: AST_AWAIT
nodes.rationale: Await expressions unwrap typed Future<T> payloads and integrate with coroutine suspension/resumption.
